variants.matrix_both: baseline then CW90 and half-scale read_all restricted to requested QR/DataMatrix/Aztec/PDF417; exact format/text union retaining baseline objects
variants.empty_half: baseline then only if no barcode decoded, one half-scale read_all restricted to requested QR/DataMatrix/Aztec/PDF417

half_scale: floor(width/2), floor(height/2); integer area-average on native luminance including odd edges; nearest integer rounding; map pixel centres (p+0.5)*source/target-0.5
rotation: CW90 exact pixel permutation; inverse point (y, original_height-1-x)
bounds: At most 3 read_all calls (both) or 2 (empty_half), each existing decoder path unchanged; no recursive retries; transformed images smaller than 16 on either axis skipped. Existing decoder internals have no hard real-time bound.
timeout_accounting: 30 seconds covers entire candidate including all passes, loading and transforms; timeout/crash means nothing read, never rescued from separately scored baseline

latency.selection: first 20 nonnegative rows at stride max(1,nrows//20) in each DEV corpus; fixed without outcomes
latency.order: per item repeat alternates baseline,candidate and candidate,baseline; single pinned CPU, no parallel benchmark workers
latency.scope: native decode+transform internal ms and whole-process wall ms; all attempted pairs retained, timeout failures reported separately and charged timeout budget
latency.gate: median paired candidate/baseline >1.05 with bootstrap95 lower>1 is regression; unchanged bench speed_ab statistic, 2000 draws seed0

promotion: No new false-decode frame, no lost baseline truth code or returned baseline object; report all per-format metrics, precision, timeouts, crashes, errors. Default stays unchanged regardless; opt-in only if exact recovery gains and measured cost useful. No TEST/reserved, no shared scorer changes, no payload/media in repository.
native_difference_from_cached_prototype: Matrix-only calls exclude linear regions and raw MaxiCode retries. Native area downsample happens after grayscale rather than OpenCV color-downsample before grayscale; result need not equal cached prototype.
